projectDescription: Triton One is a high-performance blockchain RPC infrastructure platform providing Solana developers with reliable endpoints, real-time data streaming, historical archives, and advanced trading APIs.
keyFeatures: Dragon's Mouth gRPC streaming with intra-slot updates up to 400ms faster than standard WebSockets
Whirligig WebSocket proxy — drop-in Solana WebSocket replacement powered by gRPC
Fumarole reliable streaming with persistence, replay, and consumer groups
Old Faithful — full Solana historical archive from genesis via JSON-RPC and gRPC
Cascade transaction network using Stake-Weighted Quality of Service (SWQoS)
Steamboat custom indexes reducing getProgramAccounts from seconds to milliseconds
Digital Assets API (DAS) for NFTs, compressed NFTs, and fungible tokens
Yellowstone Shield — on-chain validator allowlist/blocklist for MEV protection
Vixen modular parsing framework for program-aware real-time data pipelines
Metis and Titan swap APIs for DEX aggregation and routing on Solana
Multi-chain support: Solana, Sui, Monad, Pythnet
GeoDNS and BGP Anycast global routing with instantaneous failover
publicApiSurface: gRPC: getLatestBlockhash, getBlockHeight, getSlot, isValidBlockhash, subscribeReplayInfo
WebSocket: accountSubscribe, blockSubscribe, logsSubscribe, programSubscribe, signatureSubscribe, slotSubscribe, transactionSubscribe (Whirligig)
JSON-RPC: full Solana mainnet/testnet/devnet API compatibility

DAS API: getAsset, getAssets, getAssetProof, getAssetProofs, getAssetSignatures, getAssetsByAuthority, getAssetsByCreator, getAssetsByGroup, getAssetsByOwner, searchAssets, getTokenAccounts, getNftEditions, getTokenLargestAccounts
Old Faithful gRPC: GetTransaction, GetBlock, GetBlocktime, SearchForSlot, StreamTransactions, StreamBlocks
Yellowstone Shield CLI: policy create, policy show, identities add/update/remove
